title: leucozoma elatum
intro: Leucozoma elatum, commonly known as the mountain parnassia, is a flowering plant species in the saxifrage family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an anti-arthritic agent, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Leucozoma elatum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
